high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a social media post by Rahul Gandhi. The post reads: "Paid floral tributes to my father, Shri Rajiv Gandhi ji, on his 80th birth anniversary. Papa, your service and sacrifice for our beloved country, remains my biggest inspiration." The photo accompanying the post shows a man, presumably Rahul Gandhi, standing outdoors under a light rain. He is dressed in a white kurta and appears to be performing a ritual or paying respects. In front of him, there is a large, ornate structure made of white flowers and petals, which seems to be a part of the tribute
